reason: The plugin is primarily an orchestration aid for DeepSeek Harness that adjusts the sequence of context messages so `subagent-settled` child responses are presented before ordinary parent messages in the same agent step, using a host Cordis plugin hook rather than changing durable storage or active request execution.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 的主机侧 Cordis 插件，在每个 Agent 步骤中将已完成的子智能体回调响应排在普通上下文之前，从而优先处理子智能体反馈。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness host-side Cordis plugin that reorders each Agent step so completed subagent callback responses are processed before ordinary context messages.

capabilities: Reorders message queueing so completed subagent responses are prioritized before ordinary parent-context messages in an agent step.
Registers through existing `agent/pre-step` extension behavior without adding a new subagent protocol.
Applies a host-side plugin patch for DeepSeek Harness integration to reshape execution context ordering only.
